newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Dutch say no decision yet on special EU meeting.
newsitem.headline: Dutch say no decision yet on special EU meeting.

text.p: The Dutch European Union presidency said on Wednesday it still had not made a decision on whether a special finance ministers meeting would be needed before the EU summit in Amsterdam on Monday.
"We haven't made a decision. It depends on the drafting," a spokesman for the foreign ministry said by telephone from The Hague.
He was referring to the drafting of a compromise that would let France agree the Stability Pact for economic and monetary union at the summit in Monday and Tuesday.
The spokesman said it was not legally necessary for there to be a meeting if an agreement was reached. It could be agreed by fax to allow the EU leaders to sign off on the issue at the summit.
Earlier in Bonn, German Finance Minister Theo Waigel said it was possible a special finance ministers meeting would be held ahead of the summit.
